name: hcp
description: Exposes this Claude Code session over HCP, with a mobile web client. Watch the session and answer its permission prompts from your phone.

escalate_from.title: Escalate to remote clients from risk level
escalate_from.description: Which classified risk levels get sent to attached HCP clients: low, medium, or high. Anything below this passes through to Claude Code's normal permission flow.

bind.title: Network binding
bind.description: "loopback" (default) keeps the server on 127.0.0.1. "lan" binds all interfaces so a phone on the same Wi-Fi can reach it — every request still needs the capability token. Only turn this on for networks you trust.
